title: rockhausenia cornea
intro: Rockhausenia cornea, commonly known as the Rock Hausenia or Hausenia cornea, is a plant species of the Rubiaceae family. It is a shrub-like plant native to tropical regions and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Rockhausenia cornea include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
